name: daum_ads-mcp
display_name: Daum search ads (now Kakao 키워드광고) MCP
description: Daum search ads (now Kakao 키워드광고) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budge

platform_mcp_daum_ads_business_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DAUM_ADS_BUSINESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_daum_ads_business_token.description: Kakao business token (비즈니스 토큰) issued by POST https://kauth.kakao.com/oauth/business/token after the advertiser consents to the keyword_management scope in your biz app (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/latest/ko/business-auth/rest-api). It has no refresh flow; it expires after long non-use.

platform_mcp_daum_ads_ad_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DAUM_ADS_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_daum_ads_ad_account_id.description: Kakao keyword ad account id (numeric, without the K prefix), sent as the `adAccountId` header that every campaign and report call requires.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET https://kapi.kakao.com/v1/business/tokeninfo: validates the business token ({id, token_user_id, biz_agreements [{group, scope, ad_account_ids}], status}).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /openapi/v1/adAccounts/pages (page is 0-based upstream): keyword ad accounts (ON and OFF) with raw.memberType and raw.config. Amounts are KRW.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /openapi/v1/campaigns for the account in the ad_account_id config (adAccountId header; account_id is not sent). `status` filters config: ON, OFF or DEL. `budget` is the daily budget in KRW (null when unset); raw.status lists the serving states. No paging.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /openapi/v1/campaigns/report?metricsGroups=BASIC&start=&end= for every campaign of the configured account (campaign_id is not a filter here). Kakao expects dates as yyyyMMdd: pass date_from/date_to like 20260901 (up to two years back). spend is KRW.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PATCH /openapi/v1/campaigns/{id}/dailyBudget {dailyBudgetAmount}: a whole number of KRW (`currency` is ignored); spends money. The campaign must belong to the configured ad account.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PATCH /openapi/v1/campaigns/{id}/onOff {id, config: OFF|ON} (only campaigns currently ON or OFF). Resuming restarts spending. Kakao answers an empty 200.
